rationale: After the Clinical Presentation block, tests ability to distinguish positive from negative symptoms — a core PS4.1 diagnostic competency.
After the Diagnosis and MSE block, tests the critical ICD-11 vs DSM-5 duration criterion difference — a high-yield PS trap that directly informs diagnostic accuracy.

After the Management block, applies pharmacological knowledge including clozapine agranulocytosis monitoring and EPS/NMS adverse-effect recognition — core PS4.1 management and adverse-effect competencies.
